name: Sunpu Castle
description: Sunpu Castle was Tokugawa Ieyasu's castle after his retirement — he ruled Japan from here in his final years. The stone walls, moats, and reconstructed gates (East Gate, 1996) anchor the modern city center; the Honmaru garden is a national historic site.
notes: Sunpu Park is free; the East Gate is open seasonally (fee).
